mapper.select: SELECT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM proj_project_plan_version WHERE tenant_id=#{query.tenantId} AND project_id=#{query.projectId}) OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM proj_project_stage WHERE tenant_id=#{query.tenantId} AND project_id=#{query.projectId}) OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM proj_project_task WHERE tenant_id=#{query.tenantId} AND project_id=#{query.projectId}) OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM proj_project_gate WHERE tenant_id=#{query.tenantId} AND project_id=#{query.projectId}) OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM proj_project_milestone WHERE tenant_id=#{query.tenantId} AND project_id=#{query.projectId}) OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM proj_project_deliverable WHERE tenant_id=#{query.tenantId} AND project_id=#{query.projectId})
mapper.update: UPDATE proj_project SET lifecycle_template_id=#{query.templateId},lifecycle_template_revision_id=#{query.revisionId}, lifecycle_template_revision_no=#{query.revisionNo},template_load_method='AUTO_DEFAULT', process_definition_key=#{query.processDefinitionKey},process_definition_version=#{query.processDefinitionVersion}, closure_policy_snapshot=#{query.closurePolicySnapshot},version=version+1, updater=#{query.updater},update_time=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3) WHERE tenant_id=#{query.tenantId} AND id=#{query.projectId} AND version=#{query.expectedVersion} AND lifecycle_status='ACTIVE' AND deleted=0 AND active_plan_version_id IS NULL AND lifecycle_template_id IS NULL AND lifecycle_template_revision_id IS NULL AND lifecycle_template_revision_no IS NULL
